title: Virtual IHC Synthesis and Bimodal Fusion for Patch-Level Classification of HER2 IHC Expression in Breast Cancer.
summary: A progressive generative model synthesized virtual HER2 immunohistochemistry from H&E images, and bimodal fusion classified four HER2-expression categories. Comparisons support patch-level technical performance, not patient-level diagnostic utility.
ai_technology: Progressive image-generation model and bimodal fusion classifier
organization: Not stated in the abstract reviewed

evidence.tested: Image-generation baselines and patch-level classification across four HER2 expression categories were compared.
evidence.unknown: Patch-level technical evaluation does not establish patient-level diagnostic accuracy or clinical utility.
evidence.ai_role: Progressive image-generation model and bimodal fusion classifier

source_review.scope: Primary result-bearing material for the stated method, result and evaluation, with bibliographic version information.
